system: Chronicles of Swarajya: Universal Item Registry

wood_sagwan.name: Sagwan Teak Wood
wood_sagwan.description: Dense, water-resistant teak timber harvested from Sahyadri groves. Essential for tool handles, scabbards, and fortified gate construction.

ore_iron.name: Sahyadri Hematite Iron Ore
ore_iron.description: Rich ironstone extracted from Deccan basalt outcrops. Refined by blacksmiths into deadly talwars, spearheads, and armour plates.

leather_hide.name: Tanned Buffalo Hide
leather_hide.description: Thick, oil-cured leather used for grip bindings, kamarbandh straps, brigandine foundations, and dhal shield facings.

gold_huns.name: Swarajya Gold Huns
gold_huns.description: Official gold currency of the realm. Accepted by village smiths, merchants, and armourers across Maharashtra.

talwar_basic.name: Forged Steel Talwar
talwar_basic.description: Hand-forged curved steel talwar with a brass disc pommel. Well-balanced for swift slashes against raiders and sentries.

talwar_upgraded.name: Pattisa Reinforced Talwar
talwar_upgraded.description: Master-forged high-carbon steel talwar with double fullers and spiked basket hilt. Cleaves through enemy mail with ease.

heavy_curved_sword.name: Khanda Heavy Broadsword
heavy_curved_sword.description: Broad double-edged blade reinforced with a spine plate. Delivers crushing downward cleaves capable of staggering shielded foes.

spear_bamboo.name: Maratha Long Bhala (Spear)
spear_bamboo.description: A 10-foot bamboo shaft tipped with a leaf-shaped steel point. Keeps fierce charging enemies and mounted scouts at distance.

bow_composite.name: Sahyadri Teak Composite Bow
bow_composite.description: Reinforced recurve bow made of horn, teak, and sinew. Fires armour-piercing arrows with great accuracy.

dhal_shield_basic.name: Maratha Dhal Buckler
dhal_shield_basic.description: Convex buffalo-hide shield studded with four polished brass bosses. Absorbs incoming melee blows and projectile fire.

dhal_shield_reinforced.name: Iron-Banded Dhal Greatshield
dhal_shield_reinforced.description: Heavy rhino-hide dhal banded in damascened steel plates. Completely deflects ordinary enemy arrows and reduces heavy boss impact.

angarkha_traditional.name: Traditional Cotton Angarkha
angarkha_traditional.description: Pleated off-white tunic with saffron trim. Offers maximum mobility and heat dissipation through the rugged Sahyadri trails.

armour_leather_brigandine.name: Riveted Leather Brigandine
armour_leather_brigandine.description: Hardened buffalo-hide vest fitted with overlapping internal iron scales. Substantially reduces slash damage.

armour_chainmail_zirah.name: Maratha Zirah Chainmail Hauberk
armour_chainmail_zirah.description: Interlinked riveted iron rings layered over quilted cotton gambeson. Protects vital organs against thrusts, arrows, and sabres.

pheta_royal.name: Crimson & Saffron Pheta
pheta_royal.description: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj's iconic royal turban pinned with a jeweled Sirpech brooch and white plume. Symbol of Hindavi Swarajya.

mojari_leather.name: Pointed Leather Mojari Boots
mojari_leather.description: Traditional curved-toe footwear built from thick cured leather with reinforced soles for gripping wet basalt rocks.

salve_healing.name: Sahyadri Herbal Healing Salve
salve_healing.description: Potent medicinal paste prepared by village elders from crushed neem leaves and wild mountain honey. Restores 50 HP immediately.

key_kot_fort.name: Kot Fort Gateway Key
key_kot_fort.description: Heavy wrought-iron key recovered from the enemy outpost commander. Unlocks the monumental ironwood gate of Kot Fort.
